rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a head-to-head contest, battle, or struggle between people, groups, forces, or ideas.

example.english: The duel between the two teams on the field was exciting.
example.traditional: 球場上兩隊嘅對決好精彩。
example.jyutping: kau4 coeng4 soeng6 loeng5 deoi6 ge3 deoi3 kyut3 hou2 zing1 coi2

rows.note: Use this for an arranged one-on-one combat, especially a traditional honor duel rather than a general contest.

example.english: The two men arranged a duel on the night of the full moon over their honor.
example.traditional: 兩個人為咗名譽，約好喺月圓之夜決鬥。
example.jyutping: loeng5 go3 jan4 wai6 zo2 ming4 jyu6 joek3 hou2 hai2 jyut6 jyun4 zi1 je6 kyut3 dau3
